title: Customer success criteria and feedback integration for private-beta exit
creator: Riya Gupta
description: Goal: Coordinate cross-team tasks required to move a closed private beta cohort into an intentionally phased GA launch. This ticket captures success criteria for customers in the private beta, the release-notes and comms coordination plan, and an operational feedback integration process so engineering, product and CS can act on issues discovered by pilot customers. Scope includes: release notes synchronization, one-page runbook for launch ops, post-beta feedback triage process, success metric dashboard, and liaison points for support/solutions engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized customer success criteria doc reviewed by Product, CS, and Eng leads
Release notes ready and approved 7 business days before public announcement
Feedback ingestion workflow implemented and tested with at least 2 pilot accounts
Rollout checklist completed in Console for canary->regional rollout
KPI dashboard for beta exit (latency, error-rate, customer satisfaction, cost delta) published and shared
tasks: Draft customer success criteria and acceptance checklist (PM)
Coordinate release-notes draft with Docs and Eng (PM + Tech Writer)
Create CS playbook for pilot account outreach and escalation paths (CS)
Define feedback webhooks and tagging conventions (Eng)
Implement triage board in Linear with triage labels and SLAs (PM + Support)
Schedule release notes review and legal sign-off meeting (PM)
Run a mock 'beta exit' incident drill with Solutions Eng and Oncall (SRE)
Publish success-metrics dashboard and grant view access to stakeholders (Observability)
Prepare customer-facing FAQ and known-issues doc for initial cohort (PM + Docs)
Finalize rollout gating criteria (error-rate, latency, feature flags) (Eng + PM)
communication_plan: Weekly cross-functional sync (Mon 10:00 PST) during execution window
Release notes channel created in #release-notes and linked to drafts
Daily status standups three days prior to public announcement
Customer advisory emails coordinated with CS 48 hours before rolling to that cohort
Internal launch brief shared as 1-pager and recorded demo for support teams
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Stability sign-off (internal canary for 3 days with <0.5% 5xx)
Phase 1: Pilot cohort (10 accounts) — manual enable, CS engagement
Phase 2: Lighthouse expansion (20 accounts) — automated enable with throttled traffic
Phase 3: Regional canary (selected regions at 5% traffic) — monitoring for regressions
Phase 4: Public GA (feature flag removed; release notes published)
Rollback plan: automatic re-route to compatible model variant + rollback playbook in Console
feedback_integration_map: Feedback channels: in-product reporter, CS tickets, dedicated pilot Slack channel
Tagging: use label 'beta-exit' + component tags (runtime/api/console) on all feedback
Ingestion: webhooks -> triage board in Linear -> auto-assign to Eng or Docs based on tag
SLA: triage within 72 hours; P0 responses within 4 hours
Closed-loop: monthly feedback review that maps issues to changelog entries or follow-up tickets
success_metrics: R1: Mean latency (p50/p95) change <= 10% relative to baseline
R3: Customer NPS from pilot accounts >= +20 (post-integrations)
R4: Time-to-first-response for pilot bugs <= 4 hours
R5: Percentage of pilot feedback resolved or acknowledged within 30 days >= 85%
R6: Unit token cost delta per 1k tokens measured and documented
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Late engineering regressions discovered during pilot — Mitigation: freeze non-critical changes 48h before phase 1 and require sign-off
Risk: Release notes missing behavioral changes — Mitigation: create a release-notes checklist template and require Docs sign-off
Risk: CS overwhelmed by incoming issues — Mitigation: limit pilot cohort lines to assigned Solutions Eng and prebuilt FAQ
Risk: Privacy/compliance flag during private beta — Mitigation: escalate to Legal immediately and pause rollout for affected accounts
